skills.name: cads-project-cold-start
skills.description: Use on first contact, a new or stale AI session, or unknown project context to reconstruct repository/runtime truth before planning; do not use as a persisted phase.

skills.name: cads-product-goal-framing
skills.description: Use for a new or changed Product Goal, missing acceptance, or material design assumptions to frame Goal/CUJ/acceptance and surface only material concerns.

skills.name: cads-architecture-description
skills.description: Use when durable system shape, technology, state, runtime, deployment, or trust boundaries are material or changing; omit for tiny reversible implementation choices.

skills.name: cads-external-skill-acquisition
skills.description: Use only after targeted investigation identifies a materially useful reusable external specialist Agent Skill; vet and pin exact docs-only content before persistent use, not for ordinary web research.

skills.name: cads-goal-execution
skills.description: Use after Goal and acceptance are clear to implement the smallest coherent change and collect relevant verification evidence.

skills.name: cads-systematic-debugging
skills.description: Use for an actual reproducible defect or failed acceptance path to observe, isolate root cause, repair minimally, and reverify; do not use as a generic planning phase.

skills.name: cads-product-acceptance
skills.description: Use before material FIXED, DONE, READY, release-ready, or product-complete claims to prove predefined Goal acceptance on the actual supported surface with matching evidence.

skills.name: cads-workspace-hygiene
skills.description: Use only when workspace bloat, competing worklines, or closure residue materially obstructs current work; do not clean unrelated Owner work.

skills.name: cads-user-facing-workflow
skills.description: Use when a user-facing Goal changes journey, navigation, discoverability, handoffs, or next-action clarity.

skills.name: cads-frontend-design
skills.description: Use when implementing or materially changing a user-facing screen, component, interaction, or layout and rendered frontend quality matters.

skills.name: cads-ui-quality-review
skills.description: Use before user-facing acceptance or when usability, accessibility, responsiveness, state clarity, or recovery quality is in doubt.
